updateLog: 🔔 Reminder: take a backup before updating via Settings > Export screen > Export
🚀 Noize 1.0.0 is here with unified media_kit playback, equalizer Curve mode, gapless playback, voice search, and audio caching
🎵 Added expanded related songs queue support up to 250 from search
🌍 Added translations and improved language-specific home titles
🛠 Improved playback reliability, equalizer stability, and downloads experience
features: Built-in equalizer with Curve mode and presets
Voice search and expanded queue support
Background playback with Windows SMTC integration
Download songs and playlists for offline use
Light, Dark, and System theme modes
bugFixes: Fixed low-quality thumbnail support in media notifications
Fixed YouTube / YT Music button and translation mismatches
Fixed equalizer crashes and audio playback issues
Improved resume playback, lyrics handling, and download controls
releaseNotes: Noize 1.0.0 brings unified media_kit playback, equalizer Curve mode, gapless playback, voice search, and wider translation support. Please backup your data before updating: Settings > Export screen > Export.
